CF1.name: Line C sign audit
CF1.plan_definition: State what the sign of rho means and recompute with an orientation-explicit sensitivity metric
CF1.plan_refutation: Lazertinib and Neratinib dropped as vulnerabilities if positive rho means higher viability (resistance) at a high checkpoint score
CF1.reading: rho > 0 means lower viability in weak-checkpoint lines, i.e. sensitivity; Lazertinib and Neratinib are not dropped on sign grounds
CF1.result_line: Lazertinib: delta -0.375, adjusted rho 0.14; Neratinib: delta -0.459, adjusted rho 0.187; orientation sanity median LFC Bortezomib -4.17, Colchicine -1.8, Paclitaxel -2.23, Vincristine -1.81
CF1.test: positive rho: viability against the checkpoint score; orientation-explicit quartile delta

CF2.name: Tubulin-class enrichment among line C survivors
CF2.plan_definition: Hypergeometric test of the four tubulin-class survivors among the 190 estimable drugs
CF2.plan_refutation: If enriched, the score is treated as a mitotic-dependency control, not a source of candidates
CF2.reading: enriched: the score behaves as a mitotic-dependency control and the four stay hazard-class
CF2.result_line: 4 of 6 survivors are tubulin-class; 5 of 190 estimable drugs are; expected 0.158; hypergeometric p 1.41e-06

CF3.name: Engine specificity
CF3.plan_definition: Rank of each drug for BUB1B against degree-matched random genes
CF3.plan_refutation: Drug not above the null: close the row
CF3.reading: title/abstract co-mention of the drug with BUB1B is not above 99 degree-matched genes; only the co-mention leg is tested and aliases such as BubR1 are not searched
CF3.result_line: Olaparib 0 vs null median 0 (p 1); Progesterone 4 vs null median 0 (p 0.17); Tyrosine 6 vs null median 1 (p 0.23); Vorinostat 1 vs null median 0 (p 0.14); Zinc Chloride 0 vs null median 0 (p 1)
CF3.test: BUB1B co-mention count against 99 degree-matched random genes (Europe PMC)
CF3.verdict_summary: Olaparib refuted, Progesterone refuted, Tyrosine refuted, Vorinostat refuted, Zinc Chloride refuted

CF4.name: Graph path audit (line A)
CF4.plan_definition: List drug-to-disease paths; check each edge for a source and for generic hub nodes
CF4.plan_refutation: All paths pass through hubs or lack a primary source: close
CF4.reading: hub-free paths of at most 4 edges exist, so line A is not refuted; this is a permissive check (most drugs with targets have such paths) and edge sources are not recorded per edge in PrimeKG
CF4.result_line: Disopyramide: hub-free query nodes reached 7; Pomalidomide: hub-free query nodes reached 7
CF4.test: hub-free paths of length <= 4 from drug to the query nodes in PrimeKG

CF5.name: B2 scheme sensitivity
CF5.plan_definition: Recompute support under the other weighting schemes and against random genes
CF5.plan_refutation: Not in the top set under any other scheme: close
CF5.reading: support is not specific to scheme W3 if the drug is in the top set under W1 or W2 and above random modules
CF5.result_line: Ceritinib: top set W1 True, W2 True, random-module p 0.0099; Selinexor: top set W1 True, W2 True, random-module p 0.0099; Tirbanibulin: top set W1 True, W2 True, random-module p 0.0198
CF5.test: top set under W1/W2 from stored scores; rank against 100 random degree-matched modules
CF5.verdict_summary: Ceritinib survives, Selinexor survives, Tirbanibulin survives

CF6.name: Line D sign permutation
CF6.plan_definition: Sign-permutation null and re-check of the control drugs
CF6.plan_refutation: Net signed effect inside the null range: close
CF6.reading: signed-path nets are compared with sign-shuffled networks of the same topology; controls not above chance
CF6.result_line: Erdafitinib: net 34, null range [-10, 39], p 0.0709; Nirogacestat: net 49, null range [-29, 41], p 0.003; Regorafenib: net 94, null range [6.98, 118], p 0.121; Ritlecitinib: net 39, null range [-10, 41], p 0.047; Sunitinib: net 57, null range [-5.02, 69], p 0.105; controls recovered 4/6 (null p 0.0539)
CF6.test: net signed effect against 1,000 sign-shuffled networks; control re-check
CF6.verdict_summary: Erdafitinib refuted, Nirogacestat survives, Regorafenib refuted, Ritlecitinib refuted, Sunitinib refuted

CF7.name: Line E-P leave-one-array-out
CF7.plan_definition: Leave-one-array-out on the 2 case versus 4 control arrays; reversal in the BUB1B and Track 1 signatures
CF7.plan_refutation: Reversal q at or above 0.10 in any leave-out, or concordance with the disease signature: close or flag hazard (DESIGN CHOICE threshold)
CF7.reading: reversal must hold with q < 0.10 in all six leave-outs and the drug must not mimic the BUB1B or Track 1 signature
CF7.result_line: Amphotericin B: max q 0.184, failed leave-outs 3, concordant False; Auranofin: max q 0.391, failed leave-outs 5, concordant False; Fluvastatin: max q 0.153, failed leave-outs 4, concordant False; Nelfinavir: max q 0.222, failed leave-outs 4, concordant False; Neratinib: max q 0.153, failed leave-outs 3, concordant False
CF7.test: six leave-outs of the 2 case vs 4 control arrays; concordance with BUB1B/Track 1 signatures
CF7.verdict_summary: Amphotericin B refuted, Auranofin refuted, Fluvastatin refuted, Nelfinavir refuted, Neratinib refuted

definition_strings.src/track2/line_c_adjusted.py:76-93: partial_perm: rho_adj is the partial rank correlation of the viability rank with the score rank (same orientation as the unadjusted rho)
definition_strings.src/track2/multi_evidence_completion.py:: score = mean over cell lines of the z-scored expression of BUB1B, BUB1, BUB3, MAD1L1, MAD2L1, TTK; low = weak checkpoint; statistic = Spearman rho between PRISM viability (log fold change) and the score; rho > 0 = more lethal when the checkpoint is weak
definition_strings.src/track2/prism_l4.py:43-60: sac_scores: mean_all = mean of per-gene z-scores of log2(TPM+1) of BUB1B, BUB1, BUB3, MAD1L1, MAD2L1, TTK per cell line (high = strong checkpoint)
definition_strings.src/track2/prism_l4.py:5-6: difference in mean viability (log fold change) between weak-SAC and strong-SAC groups (negative = the drug kills weak-SAC cells more)
definition_strings.src/track2/vulnerability_core.py:4: diff = mean of the weak-score quartile minus mean of the strong-score quartile (negative = the row is lower, i.e. more lethal, when the score is weak)

documentation.reading: viability is a log fold change (negative = fewer cells); score low = weak checkpoint; therefore rho > 0 means low-score (weak-checkpoint) lines have lower viability = more sensitive; positive rho is sensitivity, not resistance
